TEST THIS ONE FIRST. ELITE PLAYERS LOSE THEIR IMMUNITY TO A BAD FIRST TOUCH. ONE FIELD. trap.ballControlRate (constant::Trap +0x38; consumers 0x144079c38 / 0x144079dc3 inside 0x144079a70 and 0x14407aab5 inside 0x14407a9f0, all reached only via match::anime::action::Trap). WHO IT AFFECTS: EVERYONE, identically - your stick-controlled player, your AI team-mates and the CPU. WHAT IT DOES: the random error the game adds to the ball's velocity on a first touch is U1*(1-f)*(2+0.1X) + U2*(1-f^2)*D km/h, where f = clamp01((BallControl - weakFootDeduction - lo)/(hi-lo)) * ballControlRate. At the stock rate of 1.0 a Ball Control 99 player reaches f = 1.0 exactly, so (1-f) and (1-f^2) are both exactly zero and his first touch carries EXACTLY ZERO error in every situation, at every ball speed. That is the reason elite players never mis-control, and no exe re-aim inside the error builder can change it - four different re-aims were emulated and every one still leaves BC99 at exactly 0.000 while the rate is 1.0. The dt270 field is the gate. Setting it to 0.85 gives BC99 the (1-f) = 0.15 that a BC90 player has today, leaves BC40 completely unchanged at 1.0, and preserves the ability ORDER - only the top of the range loses its immunity. EVIDENCE: a-EMULATED. The game's own trap-error code was run under Unicorn from the PRISTINE image, 200 draws of its own 6-sample average, mean error magnitude in km/h added to the ball's velocity:
    rate 1.00 (stock): BC40 12.06 | BC75 5.80 | BC90 2.10 | BC99 0.00   (on a 70 km/h relative ball)
    rate 0.85:         BC40 11.75 | BC75 7.01 | BC90 3.81 | BC99 2.12
    rate 0.70:         BC40 12.01 | BC75 8.17 | BC90 5.76 | BC99 4.25
That is the owner's brief met directly: mis-hits that scale with ability in BOTH frequency and severity, and that reach elite players. It also lowers the controllable-ball-speed threshold (15 + 20f^2 + 3g): BC99 38.0 -> 34.7 km/h, so a very fast ball is harder to kill for everyone. WHAT TO LOOK FOR IN ONE MATCH: your best player, receiving a driven pass while turning or under pressure, occasionally taking a touch a yard heavier than he meant to - not every time, but no longer never. THE FAILURE MODE: if your best players look CLUMSY rather than human - heavy touches on simple square passes in space - go to 0.90. If it is too subtle to notice at all, go to 0.80. Revert: python tools/gameplay_tune.py restore
CONFLICTS - IMPORTANT: tools/data/tunings/loose-realism-v1.json (0.8) and loose-realism-v2.json (0.65) also write this same field, as does everything under tools/data/tunings/proven/. Do NOT stack this with either. Verified on 2026-09-18 that the live value is 1.0 (python tools/gameplay_tune.py get trap ballControlRate -> 1), so nothing is currently applied and this is a clean starting point. NO DRY-RUN EXISTS for dt270 packs: verification here is tools/tuning_liveness.py check (status 'read', 3 readers) plus reading the live value back with gameplay_tune get. APPLY: python tools/gameplay_tune.py apply tools/data/tunings/freeball-firsttouch.json --stack

edits._note: 1.0 -> 0.85. The ONLY lever demonstrated to make a 99-Ball-Control player mis-control at all. Ability order preserved: BC40 is untouched, BC99 moves from immune to roughly where BC90 is today.
